name: Corvalle General Hospital Emergency Department
bio: Level II trauma center with a 24-hour emergency department. Board-certified emergency physicians handle heart attacks, strokes, serious injuries and severe dehydration needing IV fluids.

name: Northside Regional Medical Center Emergency
bio: Full-service emergency department open around the clock, with an on-site cardiac catheterization lab and CT imaging for chest pain and severe abdominal pain.

name: Southpoint Community Hospital Emergency
bio: Community hospital emergency room serving the south side 24 hours a day. Treats serious injuries, breathing problems, high fevers and vomiting that won't stop.

name: St. Aldric Children's Pediatric Emergency
bio: Emergency department staffed by pediatric emergency specialists, for children and teens only. Open 24/7 for infant fevers, breathing trouble, seizures and dehydration.

name: Downtown QuickCare
bio: Walk-in urgent care for everyday illness. Rapid strep and flu testing on site, plus care for minor cuts and pink eye. Open every day until 8 pm.

name: Riverwalk Urgent Care
bio: Urgent care with a focus on stomach illness. Treats food poisoning, stomach bugs, vomiting and diarrhea, and gives IV fluids for mild to moderate dehydration. Spanish spoken.

name: Northside Express Care
bio: Urgent care with on-site X-ray for sprains, simple fractures and sports injuries. Splinting and crutches available. Open daily 8 am to 8 pm.

name: Little Sprouts Pediatric Urgent Care
bio: Urgent care just for kids, staffed by pediatric providers. Handles ear infections, fevers, croup and small injuries in a child-friendly setting.

name: Eastgate Walk-In Clinic
bio: Neighborhood walk-in clinic with bilingual English and Spanish staff. Common visits include urinary tract infections, coughs, bronchitis and sinus infections.

name: Eastgate Sports & Injury Urgent Care
bio: Injury-focused urgent care run by sports medicine providers. Same-day X-ray and bracing for ankle sprains, knee and wrist injuries from sports or falls.

name: Southpoint Urgent Care
bio: Urgent care experienced in wound care: stitches, minor burns, animal bites and tetanus shots. Open daily until 8 pm.

name: Southpoint Same-Day Care
bio: Same-day care for skin problems such as rashes, hives, poison ivy and insect bites, plus mild allergic reactions that don't affect breathing.

name: Westfield Urgent Care
bio: General urgent care on the west side for flu, fevers, sore throats, ear pain and minor injuries. Not in the Harbor Bronze Local network.

name: Westfield Family Urgent Care
bio: Family urgent care seeing kids and adults for ear infections, pink eye, colds and stomach bugs. Bilingual staff.

name: Dr. Elena Marsh
bio: Family physician caring for patients of all ages, from checkups and vaccines to follow-up after an urgent care or ER visit.

name: Dr. Samuel Okafor
bio: Internist focused on long-term adult health: blood pressure, diabetes and cholesterol management, and workups for ongoing fatigue.

name: Priya Natarajan
bio: Nurse practitioner offering women's health visits, contraception counseling and annual checkups. Not accepting new patients.

name: Dr. Marcus Hale
bio: Family doctor treating back pain, sinus problems and mild asthma, with same-week appointments for new patients.

name: Dr. Lina Haddad
bio: Pediatrician for newborns through teens: well-child visits, vaccines, ear infections and childhood asthma.

name: Dr. Tomás Reyes
bio: Bilingual internist serving the Spanish-speaking community, with a focus on diabetes, blood pressure and ongoing stomach problems.

name: Dr. Grace Liu
bio: Family physician who sees adults and children for checkups, recurring headaches, skin concerns and minor injuries.

name: Jordan Ellis
bio: Physician assistant offering sports physicals and visits for colds and minor infections.

name: Dr. Amara Bello
bio: Internist specializing in older adults: memory concerns, fall prevention and managing several medications. Not accepting new patients.

name: Dr. Henrik Lund
bio: Family practice with Saturday morning hours for colds, stomach upset and minor injuries.

name: Dr. Rosa Delgado
bio: Bilingual pediatrician seeing children for fevers, rashes, vaccines and well-child visits.

name: Dr. Kwame Asante

name: Dr. Nadia Petrov

name: Dr. Ethan Brooks

name: Mei Tanaka
bio: Nurse practitioner at the student health center caring for young adults: colds, stress, sleep problems and sexual health.

name: NightOwl Virtual Care
bio: Video visits with a licensed clinician 24 hours a day, usually within 15 minutes. Common late-night visits include food poisoning, vomiting, colds and rashes reviewed by photo.

name: Evergreen Health Virtual Visits
bio: Evergreen Health members' own 24/7 video visit service with no copay, for colds, flu, allergies, UTIs and stomach bugs.

name: Summit Care Telehealth
bio: Summit Care members' video visits from 7 am to 10 pm for colds, sinus infections, pink eye and minor rashes.

name: KidsLine Pediatric Telehealth
bio: Video visits with pediatric clinicians from 7 am to 10 pm for children's fevers, rashes, ear pain and vomiting.

name: Campus Connect Telehealth
bio: 24/7 video visits for students and young adults, covering colds, food poisoning, stress and minor injury questions.

name: Dr. Ana Moreira

name: Dr. Benjamin Ortiz

name: Dr. Chloe Martin

name: Brightwater Medical Center

name: Brightwater Injury & X-ray Care
bio: Injury-focused urgent care with digital X-ray on site. Splints, braces and crutches for sprains, wrist fractures and sports injuries.

name: Lakeview Stomach & Hydration Clinic
bio: Walk-in clinic for stomach illness by the lake. Treats food poisoning, vomiting and diarrhea, with IV fluids for mild dehydration.

name: Orchard Hill Kids Urgent Care

name: Millbrook Skin & Allergy Walk-In

name: Brightwater Family Walk-In

name: Dr. Ruth Mbeki

name: Dr. Joaquin Achterberg

name: Dr. Darius Halvorsen

name: Dr. Darius Fairbanks

name: Dr. Bram Mbeki

name: Dr. Ximena Nakamura

name: Dr. Malik Mbeki

name: Community Care Virtual Clinic
